name: College of Agriculture, Food and Environmental Sciences
advice: Plan around labs, fieldwork, and hands-on commitments. Add preparation and travel time to your calendar.

name: College of Architecture and Environmental Design
advice: Break studio projects into research, concept development, drafting, model-making, revisions, and presentation milestones.

name: College of Engineering
advice: Schedule consistent problem-solving sessions, start team projects early, and use office hours before you fall behind.

name: College of Liberal Arts
advice: Break reading and writing into manageable sessions: reading notes, research, outlining, drafting, and revision.

name: College of Science and Mathematics
advice: Practice throughout the semester and reserve dedicated time for lab preparation, reports, and cumulative exam review.

name: Orfalea College of Business
advice: Use shared calendars for team projects and set internal deadlines ahead of official due dates.
